Definition: diminutive of G4251; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman:--Priscilla.
BiblicalUsage: Priscilla is the diminutive, little Prisca, and Luke uses it for the same woman. Paul finds her with Aquila at Corinth, newly come from Italy, and stays to work with them. Later they take Apollos aside and expound the way of God to him more perfectly.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Priscilla's quiet teaching changed the church: she and Aquila took a gifted preacher aside and made his preaching true. That is the work of a teacher, done without a platform.
